interpolation: periodic_cubic centerline; cyclic PCHIP widths; unchanged CSV
surface: Flat, zero wind, nominal friction1; model-specific load/aero closures in model_info
common_controller: five-state kinematic tracking NMPC; fixed settings for all plants
force_input_slip_kind: Instantaneous wheel slip, no relaxation states
torque_allocation: static axle load fractions, equal left/right; mass800kg radius0.3m
limitations: Normalized model-family comparison, not an exact thesis/controller reproduction or real-car validation; timing depends on implementation/language and host.

model_info.adaptations: Source yaw-roll and coupled-brush structure, common vehicle coefficients; actual radial peak normalized via internal mu=49/45 for mu_s/mu=11/12. OCD-derived roll inertia/stiffness/damping and quasi-static load closure independent of roll states, CG aero and common wheel drivetrain/PT1 added. Not calibrated P1 suspension reproduction
model_info.operating_domain: Forward motion; numerical denominator floor 1 m/s; RK4 post-step steering projection, plus nonnegative wheel projection where wheel states exist
model_info.reference_point: State U,V is roll-base; public velocities and global position are CG
model_info.load_closure: Quasi-static force/load equilibrium at CG height0.3m; roll does not feed normal loads
